results.title: Customer refund process (how to get money back on an order)
results.content: A customer requests a refund within 30 days of purchase from the Orders page in the app, and the money returns to the original payment method within 5-7 business days (b-208, verified public FAQ). Customers who were double-charged at checkout or charged despite a failed payment also go through refund requests, as shown by East China support tickets (b-207, verified). Memory holds no further detail on approval steps or exceptions to the 30-day window.
